typography.notes: Do not use Inter for headings. Keep typographic scales moderate for dashboard legibility.

layout_and_spacing.containers: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 mb-6
layout_and_spacing.edit_box_grid: Grid layout MUST be properly proportioned. Wrap in a grid-cols-12 gap-6. Set 'Biogenic' fields to col-span-3 or col-span-4, and 'Reporting Month' to col-span-4 or col-span-5 to prevent reporting month from being too narrow. Eliminate unnecessary blank columns.
layout_and_spacing.general: Use generous internal padding (p-4 to p-6) within cards. Avoid tight, crammed data views.

form_fields.select_dropdowns: Add leading icons inside Shadcn SelectTrigger. Add 'pl-10' to the trigger text container, and position the icon absolutely (left-3, top-1/2, -translate-y-1/2) with size 16px.
form_fields.radio_buttons: Override default blue active state. Use custom green accent classes (e.g., text-emerald-600 ring-emerald-600 border-emerald-600) for active/checked states on Scope 1, 2, 3, and biogenic radio groupings.

calculated_emissions.header: Replace generic calc icon with lucide-react 'Leaf' icon (text-emerald-500) next to the section title.
calculated_emissions.disclaimer_badge: Convert '(Values rounded to 4 decimal places)' to a pill badge: flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500. Place an 'Info' icon (12px) on the right side.
calculated_emissions.emission_cards: Remove solid grey backgrounds. Apply 'emission_tints' colors (red, orange, yellow, green) for bg, border, and text. Add matching lucide-react icons to the left of the card content. For Scope 3 where only CO2e exists, give it a prominent, full-width or beautified UI treatment rather than a small isolated card.

calculation_details.container: Wrap this entire section in a Shadcn Accordion component, set to be collapsible and collapsed by default.
calculation_details.row_styling: Remove solid block backgrounds. Use white backgrounds with a thin bottom border (border-b border-gray-100) and py-3 for a clean list-item look.
calculation_details.source_badges: Transform plain text '(Source - IPCC 2006)' into right-aligned pill badges: bg-orange-50 border border-orange-200 text-orange-600 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium.
calculation_details.final_row: Style the final calculation row with a soft green background tint (bg-green-50), darker green border (border border-green-200), rounded-lg, and green text. Align the 'CO2e: CO2' label cleanly to the right side inside this specific container.

iconography_mapping.category: Car (text-emerald-500) for mobile, Factory for stationary, etc.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: All components must be written in .js files, not .tsx.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on ALL interactive elements, form inputs, dropdowns, cards, and vital data points for reliable testing.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays, headers, or dropdowns. Always use solid surface colors to prevent text overlapping and readability issues.
Ensure the green Scope radio buttons and form logic applies consistently across Scope 1, Scope 2, Scope 3, and Biogenic contexts.
Avoid centering dense forms or dashboard layouts. Use left-alignment (optical alignment) for clear readability.
Implement subtle hover transitions (e.g., hover:-translate-y-[1px] shadow-sm) for interactive cards and rows.
